Pooling, ordering, baselines and paired success derivations
sources.details: Image 3×4×4=48; 16-band log-mel [16,T] averaged along time gives [16]; each Linear maps to width64 in one marker slot. Mean m_b=(1/T)Σ_t M_b,t is invariant to a permutation of time frames (apart from floating reduction rounding), so cannot retain their ordering. Balanced single-pitch high/low=3+3 gives constant-answer 3/6; fixed blue gives 9/9. Pair success is correct(original) AND correct(swapped), not just swapped correctness. Hence image totals original 9+0+18=27/36, swapped 9+9+18=36/36, both 9+0+18=27/36 pairs. DPO 18−4=14/18. These are finite task arithmetic and do not infer an internal error cause.
